input.prompt: Photorealistic 3D concept render, studio-lit on a dark blue-grey cage-fighting arena background with soft vignette, rim light, subtle floor reflection. Dramatic three-quarter view, full body, PINWHEEL, an original humanoid kickboxing robot of our own design, about 1.80 m tall and lean, middleweight. Silhouette: tall and narrow-waisted with broad, squared, flat-topped shoulders and a deliberately small head, long legs built for kicking. Head: a narrow keel-shaped skull like the prow of a boat, with a single thin VERTICAL eye slot set off-centre to one side, glowing pale cyan; no visor, no face. Chest: ribbed with horizontal armoured ribs like a ribcage, no emblem, no light on the chest. Hips: each hip is covered by one smooth sculpted flowing hip cowl that wraps from the pelvis down over the top of the thigh, hiding the motors so no round drum or disc is visible from outside; below the cowl the upper thigh is thick and muscular where the motor mass sits, tapering to slim shins. Spine: an exposed segmented spine column of stacked machined vertebra blocks running up the back from pelvis to neck, visible between the back plates. Shins: compact electric actuator housings mounted high on the back of each shin, driving the ankle through twin parallel push-rods down to the foot. Feet: boxy flat-soled mechanical feet with a squared rubber toe bumper, not shoes. Livery: matte deep teal armour panels with brushed copper accents, trim and joint rings, dark graphite mechanical frame underneath. Electric quasi-direct-drive joints, no hydraulics, no hoses. Clean, plausible, engineered, like a real robot that could be built. Pose: switch-stance kickboxing guard, weight on the back leg, front knee chambered up ready to snap a side kick, fists up, torso slightly turned so the spine column is partly visible. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no markings, no decals anywhere on the robot or the background. Not white, not glossy, no round glowing chest light, no horizontal visor, no helmet, no sneakers, no flat grey disc caps on the joints.
